K1.counts: Scored canonical duplicate roots per original unit, never duplicate members or expanded forms
K1.cross_group: No within-group invariance claim for pairs in different groups
K1.invariance: For a within-group pair with one distinct original normalized label per unit, equal root counts give equal pair contributions when all pair roots receive the same collapsed label and that common label switches between the two originals; unequal counts disclose unequal weights
K1.limits: No arbitrary target-dependent prediction-swap invariance, answer-NLL invariance or semantic validity is asserted; multi-label units get no collapsed-label invariance claim
K1.population: Every accepted lane, final source group, role and registered replicate
K1.weights: Unit root count divided by all scored roots of that role in the final group

K2.classification: Compare existing-normalized saved prediction to the exact original labels of its own unit, then this pair's sibling unit, else other
K2.denominator: Available saved predictions on that target side; disclose missing prediction IDs and full table undefined if any are missing
K2.gold_check: Each scored row's original gold must belong to its mapped original lane unit
K2.missing_section: Explicitly unavailable; never fabricate absent generation
K2.pooling: No pooled lane score or either-label success metric
K2.population: Every unordered unit pair in every accepted lane, both target sides separately, every saved arm/endpoint/role/section

K5.A1: Compare saved unchanged primary sign and interval zero coverage for every contrast/endpoint/role/section/metric
K5.inference: Descriptive paired independently trained replicate mean and 95% interval; retain undefined pairs
K5.merged_group_qa: Exclude a merged acquisition QA row if any constituent unit is excluded
K5.score: Lane-only complement excludes all original units outside the independently accepted narrow lane union
K5.weighting: A2 forms/duplicate cluster first, then source group, dependence block, event, role

reporting_policy.normalization: data.normalize: Unicode casefold, whitespace, terminal .!?,;: only
